title: Quarto skills presentation
text:
Preface
Quarto is a program that allows you to create documents, reports, presentations, and websites using a single source file format. This allows you to write your content in a single format and then render it to multiple output formats, such as HTML, PDF, and Microsoft Word.

title: Prerequisites
text:
If you run quarto -v in your terminal, you will most likely get a response similar to
user@office:~$ quarto -v
bash: quarto: command not found
This means that Quarto is not installed on your system. To install Quarto, you can follow the instructions provided in the official Quarto documentation.
